name: @crc/physics
description: Composable 2D physics and pure 2D/3D geometry for CRC
author: Ben Lesh <ben@benlesh.com>

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/2d.ts src/2d-geometry.ts src/2d-testing.ts src/3d-geometry.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=esnext --sourcemap --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --external:@crc/core --external:@crc/core/internal
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.test:node: vitest run src/lib/2d/public-types.test.ts src/lib/2d/shapes.test.ts src/lib/2d/collision src/lib/2d/world src/lib/3d/shapes.test.ts src/lib/3d/collision --browser.enabled=false --environment node
